name: com.alderflux/msgmesh
title: MsgMesh
description: Event bus for AI agents: watch_topic long-polls live events; manage topics, schemas, webhooks.

environmentVariables.name: MQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: MsgMesh API key. Sign one (admin scope recommended) at https://msgmesh-panel.alderflux.com Keys page.

environmentVariables.name: MQ_CONTROL_PLANE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Control-plane base URL. Override only when self-hosting.

environmentVariables.name: MQ_GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway (publish/consume) base URL. Override only when self-hosting.

environmentVariables.name: MQ_REALTIME_URL
environmentVariables.description: Realtime (presence) base URL. Override only when self-hosting.
